description: Bind a channel-points reward to each Govee light. Viewers redeem, type a colour (or "off"), and the bot drives that light. One reward per light.
degraded: Could not reach the backend. Try again in a moment.
keyHelpPre: In the Govee Home app, go to
keyHelpPost: Govee usually sends the key by email. Paste it here. It is stored encrypted and never shown back.
devicesError: Could not reach Govee to load your lights. Your key is still saved. Try again in a moment.
devicesKeyRejected: Govee no longer accepts this API key. Choose Remove key, then paste a new key from the Govee Home app.
noDevices: No Govee devices found on this account.
noDevicesBody: Add your lights in the Govee Home app and connect them to Wi-Fi, then choose Refresh lights.
noLights: No colour-capable Govee lights found on this account.
deleteBody: This removes the Twitch reward for {name} and unbinds the light. Deleting a Twitch reward cannot be undone.
editorHintNames: Viewers type a colour when they redeem: a name like
allowOffLabel: Let viewers turn the light off
allowOffHint: A viewer can type off to turn this light off.
liveOnlyOn: Redemptions only work while your stream is live (recommended).
liveOnlyOff: Off: viewers can change this light even when you are offline.
discardBody: You have unsaved changes to this reward. Discard them?
keyRemoveBody: The bot stops driving your lights until you paste a key again. Your rewards stay on Twitch.
keyInvalid: Govee did not accept this key. Check it and try again.
keyUnchecked: Key saved, but Govee did not answer, so it is not checked yet. Your lights will work once Govee is back. If they do not, paste the key again.
noLightsBody: Add a light to your Govee account in the Govee app. Only models that support colour appear here.
errCost: Enter a whole number of points, at least 1.
errCooldown: Enter a cooldown between 0 seconds and 7 days.
